name: DRAGON MASTER Silk
original_name: ドラゴンマスターシルク
source:
The plot of this semi-comical RPG is rather simple: an angelic creature named Silk must defeat the Prince of Darkness, who rules his own dungeon full of claustrophobic corridors and monsters. Aided by her lovely companions Ao, Aka, and Ki (which means blue, red, and yellow in Japanese), Silk must deal withe the evil Prince and his minions.

Dragon Master Silk is a dungeon crawler with Japanese-style turn-based combat. The entire game is viewed from first person perspective. The largest bulk of the game is navigating 3D dungeons, fighting regular enemies and bosses. The game maintains a distinct comical style, evident in graphics and character design.

[from [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/42740/dragon-master-silk/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
这款半喜剧角色扮演游戏的情节相当简单：名为Silk的天使生物必须击败黑暗王子，后者统治着自己的地牢，里面充满了幽闭恐怖的走廊和怪物。在可爱的同伴Ao、Aka和Ki（日语中蓝色、红色和黄色的意思）的帮助下，Silk必须对付邪恶的王子和他的爪牙。

Dragon Master Silk是一款日式回合制战斗的地下城探索游戏。整个游戏都是以第一人称视角观看的。游戏的大部分内容是在3D地下城中航行、与普通敌人和头目战斗。该游戏保持了独特的喜剧风格，这在图形和角色设计中很明显。

[来自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/42740/dragon-master-silk/]MobyGames[/url]]
